item.title: From In-House PM to Consulting PM: What I Didn't Expect
item.content:encoded: Moving from in-house Product Management to consulting changed how I create impact. Without the same access and authority, I had to rely more on context, influence, and helping clients make decisions.

item.title: Client success starts before kickoff
item.content:encoded: Client success starts before kickoff, in how well we understand the problem, carry context forward, and set the right team up to deliver.
